core_idea: The House of Spiders: The Pinky Apprentice Sinclair is a Damage Dealer — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 6 Poise (max +2); Base Power +1 per 6 Poise (max +2). **SP regenerator** — restores ally **SP** through passives and key skills.
playstyle_guide: - Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **Fallstar Slayer [落星一殺]** — **S1 — Chainstrike [連擊]** adds **+3 Poise Count** at **On Use** and **+2 Poise** per **On Hit** coin; **S2 — Nameless Slash [無名斬]** adds **+3 Poise** per **On Hit** coin and **+1 Poise Count** per **On Hit** coin. - **Fallstar Slayer [落星一殺]** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up. - Use **Haste** on attack turns — **Guard** covers defense; this is not an Evade rotation. - **SP sustain** fires at **each turn** — restores **teammates**. - **Guard: Defend [守]** grants 8 **Poise** at Combat Start — use the defense slot to prep buffs before your main attacks. - Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 6 Poise (max +2). - S3 carries Unbreakable Coin — commit it when the clash strongly favors you. **S1 — Chainstrike [連擊]** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low). - **Coin Power** scales with **Poise** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first. - Gain +3 Poise Count; [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 6 Poise on self (max 2) - Gain 2 Poise; [On Hit] Inflict +1 Bleed Count; [On Hit] Gain 1 Haste next turn (once per turn) **S2 — Nameless Slash [無名斬]** (BP 6, CP +5, x2): rolls — low 6, high 16 (Average / Slightly High stacked). - Unfocused Volley ; [On Use] Base Power +1 for every 6 Poise on self (max 2) - **Base Power** scales with **Poise** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first. - Unfocused Volley; [On Use] Base Power +1 for every 6 Poise on self (max 2) - Gain 3 Poise; [On Hit] Gain +1 Poise Count - Deal +10% damage on Critical Hit; [On Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed; [On Crit - Heads Hit] Reuse this Coin (once per Skill) **S3 — Fallstar Slayer [落星一殺]** (BP 8, CP +14, x1): rolls — low 8, high 22 (Extremely High / High stacked). - Deal +50% damage for every excess Atk Weight beyond the # of actual targets (in Focused Encounters, the Part) ; [On Use] At 20 Moonlit Azure Blade, convert all Coins of this Skill into Unbreakable Coins ; [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 4 Poise on self (max 5) ; [On Use] Base Power +1 for every 4 Moonlit Azure Blade on self (max 5) ; [On Use] Gain 7 Poise ; ; [Before Attack] Atk Weight +1 for every 10 Moonlit Azure Blade on self (max 2) ; [Attack End] Consume 5 Moonlit Azure Blade for every Atk Weight gained due to this Skill's effect - **Coin Power** scales with **Poise** (+1 per 4, max +5) — build stacks first. - **Base Power** scales with **Moonlit Azure Blade** (+1 per 4, max +5) — build stacks first. - **Atk Weight** scales with **Moonlit Azure Blade** (+1 per 10, max +2) — build stacks first. - converts coins to Unbreakable under condition - Deal +50% damage on Critical Hit; [On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed; [On Crit - Heads Hit] Deal (25% of this Coin's final damage) Slash damage Combat passive — **Singular Focus of the Mind**: Turn End: Any excess Poise Potency gained past 25 will be converted to Moonlit Azure Blade (max 15). - Combat Start: If this unit did not equip Attack Skills (including E.G.O Skills) this turn, heal 5 SP and gain 1 Slash Power Up next turn. Combat passive — **The Orthodox Blade [整劍]**: Combat Start: Gain ((Pride Reson. / 2) + 1)Poise (max 4, rounded down). - Combat End: At 20+ Poise, gain +1 Poise Count. Defense skill — **Guard: Defend [守]**: Clashable Guard. - Turn Start: At 25+ Poise, change this Skill to 'Swerve'. - [Combat Start] Gain 8 Poise (once per turn). - [Combat Start] Gain +2 Poise Count (once per turn).
